candidates.statement: Order service DB connection pool exhaustion: 36 pool waiters, postgres.acquire_connection errors (1650ms), and 10 db_pool_acquire_timeout 503 logs coincide with order p95 rising to 1300ms and gateway 'call order' errors, propagating checkout latency/errors.
candidates.uncertainty: Pool saturation cause (leak, slow queries, config) not established; payment and gateway metrics are healthy, consistent with order-local fault.

report.explanation: Order service shows DB pool waiters (36), acquire timeouts and 503s with elevated p95, while gateway traces show failing 'call order' spans and payment/gateway metrics stay healthy. This supports db-pool-exhaustion as the bounded root cause; the deployment record alone does not establish causation.
